0.$description: Zero space; use to state 'no gap' explicitly instead of a raw 0 with units.

1.$description: Space step 1 (1x the brand space base); tightest gap, e.g. icon-to-label.

2.$description: Space step 2 (2x the brand space base); compact padding and small gaps.

3.$description: Space step 3 (3x the brand space base); default control padding.

4.$description: Space step 4 (4x the brand space base); default gap between related elements.

5.$description: Space step 5 (5x the brand space base); padding for medium containers.

6.$description: Space step 6 (6x the brand space base); padding for large containers and section gaps.

7.$description: Space step 7 (8x the brand space base); separation between content groups.

8.$description: Space step 8 (10x the brand space base); separation between major regions.

9.$description: Space step 9 (12x the brand space base); large layout separation.

10.$description: Space step 10 (16x the brand space base); the largest layout separation.

sm.$description: Small uniform internal padding for compact containers (2x the brand space base).

md.$description: Default uniform internal padding for containers (4x the brand space base).

lg.$description: Generous uniform internal padding for large containers (6x the brand space base).

sm.$description: Small flex/grid gap for tightly related items (1x the brand space base).

md.$description: Default flex/grid gap between sibling elements (2x the brand space base).

lg.$description: Large flex/grid gap between loosely related groups (4x the brand space base).
